title: A periodic counterexample to the diffuse allocation characterization
description:
An explicit periodic diffuse measure on R^2 has a rooted law invariant under every measurable, pointwise-covariant, measure-preserving allocation determined by its original observed state, but fails the full joint mass-stationarity identity. The measure consists of horizontal Lebesgue lines with alternating densities one and two. Covariance and a finite per-period mass equation cover all allocations, including noninjective maps. In the defining unit-square mass-resampling experiment, the heavy-root event has probability two thirds instead of zero. A constant accompanying random element suffices. This gives a negative answer to Thorisson's historical Problem 4.1 and Last-Thorisson's Problem 7.5 in their stated unrestricted scope.

The entire existential negative conclusion is an elementary consequence of Last-Thorisson (2009), Example 7.1, their Lebesgue-product mass-stationarity proposition already in arXiv:1405.7566v1 (2014), Section 8 Proposition 1, retained in the 2015 version, and the full allocation-transfer calculation displayed in the note. Last-Thorisson (2023), Section 8 and Remark 8.1, give the canonical diffuse parallel-line/invariant-direction balancing obstruction; Khezeli-Mellick (2025), final Remark 3.2, explicitly identifies the product/atomic-quotient balancing-allocation reduction. Those balancing-existence statements have a distinct scope from the self-preserving characterization. The periodic rational-weight model is an elementary worked illustration of these established mechanisms. No new-discovery, novelty, firstness, exhaustive-priority or worldwide-current-openness claim is made. The first explicit recognition of the combined corollary and priority of the exact periodic formula remain unestablished by bounded searches.

The example is singular, two-dimensional and has a continuous translation stabilizer. It supplies no counterexample for positive-density measures, one-dimensional diffuse measures, free actions, absence of invariant directions, independent stationary backgrounds, or invariance under all preserving Markov kernels. An explicit preserving Markov kernel changes its rooted type. The exact pointwise-covariance convention is essential; an unspecified spatial-almost-everywhere representative with an unrestricted root value is a different formulation.

The deposit contains a four-page research note and a verification archive with editable source, all twenty-six frozen original files and both original evidence ZIPs, independent mathematical and bounded priority audits, source-version fingerprints, a closed-inventory verifier and a deterministic builder. Default normal and optimized finite replay is distinguished from optional provenance authentication of three complete original corpora and five original primary PDFs; additional primary-edition fingerprints and inspection records are supplied separately. Third-party publications, extracted source text, raw corpus records, page images and private credentials are excluded. Finite computations and hashes supplement the analytic proof and do not certify novelty. Compressed-byte reproducibility requires identical inputs and the same Python ZIP implementation and zlib runtime.

AI tools were used extensively in mathematical development, source review, writing, computation and adversarial checking. The recorded adversarial reviews were performed by AI agents. This is an unrefereed preprint; no completed independent human peer review or formal proof-assistant verification is claimed. The author is responsible for the claims.
